title: dcerpc-browser: Generate with pidl
description:
Combine information from the browser.idl from Samba with extra
information from the IDL embedded in Ronnie's hand-written
Browser dissector.

Use the conformance file to keep the protocol longname, shortname,
and description the same as the old one, which also keeps it from
having the same name as the SMB Browser dissector. Fix #10545.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# Conformance file for Browser
+
+# Avoid conflict with SMB Browser
+PROTOCOL browser "RPC Browser" "RPC_BROWSER" "rpc_browser"
+
+IMPORT srvsvc_NetSrvInfo100 offset = srvsvc_dissect_struct_NetSrvInfo100(tvb, offset, pinfo, tree, di, drep, hf_browser_BrowserrSrvInfo100Ctr_entries, 0);
+
+IMPORT srvsvc_NetSrvInfo101 offset = srvsvc_dissect_struct_NetSrvInfo101(tvb, offset, pinfo, tree, di, drep, hf_browser_BrowserrSrvInfo100Ctr_entries, 0);

@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
 
 set(PIDL_DISSECTOR_NAMES
 	atsvc
+	browser
 	clusapi
 	dfs
 	dnsserver
@@ -40,6 +41,9 @@ set(PIDL_DISSECTOR_NAMES
 	wzcsvc
 )
 
+set(PIDL_DISSECTOR_browser_EXTRA_DEPS
+	srvsvc/srvsvc.idl
+)
 set(PIDL_DISSECTOR_clusapi_EXTRA_DEPS
 	clusapi/clusapi.idl
 )

@@ -1,28 +1,23 @@

 #ifndef __PACKET_DCERPC_BROWSER_H

-#define BROWSER_BROWSERR_SERVER_ENUM 		0x00

-#define BROWSER_BROWSERR_QUERY_EMULATED_DOMAINS 0x0a
-#define BROWSER_BROWSERR_SERVER_ENUM_EX		0x0b
